claim.claim-text: 1. An optical fiber splice tray (100, 200), comprising:

2. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 1, wherein the containment walls (140) are configured to separate the fiber management region (120) from the splicing zones (110, 130) and guide and manage the bend radius of optical fibers routed within the optical fiber splice tray (100, 200).
3. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 1 or 2, wherein the containment walls (140) comprise a first containment wall and a second containment wall.

4. The fiber optic splice tray of any preceding claim, having a sidewall (108), and a plurality of first tabs (109) extending from the top edge of the sidewall (108) toward the interior of the optical fiber splice tray (100, 200) to control the vertical positioning of the optical fibers within the optical fiber splice tray (100, 200).

5. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, wherein the containment walls comprise second tabs (142) extending from the top edge of the containment walls (140) toward the fiber management region (120) to control the vertical positioning of the optical fibers within the optical fiber splice tray (100, 200).
6. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, wherein the fiber management region (120) is elliptical as defined by bend control walls (122).

7. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 6, wherein the bend control walls (122) comprise a plurality of third tabs (123) extending from the top edge of the bend control walls (122) toward the center of the fiber management region (120) to control vertical positioning of the optical fibers within the fiber management region (120).

8. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 6 or 7, wherein an area bounded by the bend control walls (122) is configured to store up to a meter length of 250 micron-coated optical fibers connected within the splice tray (100).

9. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, wherein the containment walls comprise fourth tabs (143) extending from the top edge of the containment walls (140) in a direction opposite the direction in which the second tabs (142) extend, to manage optical fibers entering and leaving the first and second splicing zones (110, 130), the fourth tabs (143) extending towards the free end of first tabs (109).

10. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, further comprising a sidewall (108, 208) extending from the base (102, 202) at least partially around the external perimeter of the base, the sidewall (108, 208) defining a cable entrance region (105, 205).
11. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 10, further comprising a pair of curved fiber channels (106, 206) extending from the cable entrance region (105, 205).

12. The optical fiber splice tray of claim 11, wherein the optical fiber splice tray (100, 200) is biaxially symmetric along a centerline extending between the curved fiber channels (106, 206) through the center of the fiber management region such that the first fiber splicing zone (110, 210) is disposed on one side of the centerline and the second splicing zone (120, 220) is on an opposite side of the centerline.
13. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, wherein the optical fiber splice tray has a thickness of between 4 mm and about 8 mm.
14. The optical fiber splice tray of any preceding claim, wherein the thickness of the optical fiber splice tray is about 5 mm.
15. The optical fiber splice tray of any of claims 1-11, wherein the optical fiber splice tray has an internal volume of between about 38 cm<3> and about 50 cm<3>.
